**Likely function:** a bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme, often called Nnr.

It likely repairs hydrated, inactive forms of NADH and NADPH (NAD(P)HX) through two activities: it interconverts the R and S epimers, then uses ADP to dehydrate the S form and regenerate NAD(P)H. The associated biological processes are **metabolite repair** and **nicotinamide nucleotide metabolism**. The corresponding activities are annotated as NAD(P)HX epimerase (EC 5.1.99.6) and ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase (EC 4.2.1.136).

This assignment is supported by strong sequence similarity to reviewed proteins—about 38% identity across most of the sequence—and their curated functional annotations. It is therefore a well-supported inference, not direct experimental confirmation for this particular sequence.
